Application of the path announced, present subject.
Whole path rests in consciousness; through it in void, mind, breath, channels, bodies.
Outside too in ritual objects everywhere, whole and part-wise, sequential and sudden.
Laid from awareness to outer; shine fittingly by own freedom.
Everything shines everywhere; exclusion unbearable even in dream.
Body beheld as universe-path-filled, time-painted pulse-abode.
So beheld, deity-made within the universe; meditated, worshipped, freed.
Whatever seen anywhere: reach identity-with-that there.
Offering is worship through non-difference; fullness-contemplation is meditation.
Unshaking fullness brings firmness; inner muttering makes a mantra-vessel.
Melt self-difference, bestow ray-being, fire-rite-devoted.
Equal-eyed unwaveringness: the pure vow, Nandiśikhā evenness.
Ordered sixfold practice completed: the ancients' absorption.
Materials rule-free, outward or inward; no prohibition.
Set rites unused; sacrifice arises toward occasion (Trika Sūtra).
Rule-knowing or not; gracious consciousness alone decides.
Each enjoyable becomes the rule; all employed by grace.
Tremblers forcibly diminish tremor by any means.
Doubt melts; strive; libate sense-goddesses with forbidden things.
Hero-vow saluted; doubt is impurity, weariness, contraction.
World-prison shackles; mantra letter-natured, substance five-elemented.
No mixture in the conscious living; doubt baseless.
Don't doubt; disregard dissolves it (left-hand canon).
Canon spread: doubt breeds weariness and obstacles.
Utpaladeva's all-doubt thunderbolt; lineage bows to Māheśvara.
Anuttara telos; at-length āṇava with means — propagate!
